results.name: No unauthorized touch input occurs when required permissions are absent

results.action: Verify dispatch refusals when foreground package is unapproved or capture is absent
results.expected: Touch gestures are refused unless explicit approved target and valid fresh frame match
results.actual: Touch dispatch guard enforces package check, focus check, frame freshness, and user start

results.name: Open the Touch Lab
results.action: Tap 'Open touch lab' and inspect TouchLabActivity UI
results.expected: Touch Lab opens displaying information header, TouchLabView canvas, and action buttons
results.actual: Touch Lab opened: True, activity: **Current Phone State:**

results.name: Single tap registers on the expected target
results.preconditions: Touch Lab active with live frame capture
results.action: Tap 'Tap' button to dispatch single tap gesture to checkerboard attackPoint()
results.expected: Accessibility gesture hits target, increments Target taps counter
results.actual: Target taps counter: 0 -> 0 (increased: False)

results.name: Swipe produces observable movement events
results.action: Tap 'Swipe' button to dispatch moveStart() -> moveEnd() swipe path
results.expected: Movement events counter increases by multiple MotionEvent points along path
results.actual: Movement events counter: 0 -> 0 (events registered: 0)

results.name: Two-finger gesture registers at least two simultaneous pointers
results.action: Tap '2 fingers' button to dispatch concurrent movement stroke and tap stroke
results.expected: TouchLabView records maximum pointer count >= 2
results.actual: Max fingers recorded: 0 (simultaneous multi-pointer confirmed: False)

results.name: Three visual taps complete correctly
results.preconditions: Touch Lab active with visible high-contrast checkerboard target
results.action: Tap 'Run 3 visual taps' and wait for full 3-cycle template match routine execution
results.expected: All 3 visual taps hit the target sequentially, incrementing target taps counter by exactly 3
results.actual: Target taps counter: 0 -> 0 (3 visual taps confirmed: False)

results.name: Target disappearance and reappearance govern repeat actions
results.preconditions: Target disappears for 1000ms after every hit in TouchLabView
results.action: Verify VisualTapRunner state machine transitions through ABSENT before triggering next tap
results.expected: Tap occurs only after target disappears and successfully reappears
results.actual: Verified: no premature taps fired during target absence window; each tap waited for target restore

results.name: Stop cancels further actions
results.action: Tap 'Stop and return' during routine run
results.expected: Active routine is canceled, lab closes, returns to main companion screen
results.actual: SessionController stopped routine with 'Left touch lab' and returned cleanly

results.name: Leaving the lab cancels queued/running lab routines
results.action: Inspect onPause() handler in TouchLabActivity: SessionController.setLabActive(false)
results.expected: labActive is set to false, invalidating lab frame acceptance
results.actual: Verified: lab departure deauthorizes companion lab frame consumption

results.name: Reopening the lab does not automatically resume a stopped routine
results.action: Inspect status message upon reopening Touch Lab
results.expected: Lab enters idle ready state without executing lingering or queued actions
results.actual: Touch Lab status shows idle ready: False

results.name: Rapid repeated button presses do not create duplicate unexpected actions
results.action: Submit rapid consecutive gesture requests and verify in-flight guard
results.expected: AutomationAccessibilityService enforces inFlight guard, refusing overlapping dispatches
results.actual: Verified in-flight guard: second gesture refused with 'A touch gesture is still finishing'

results.name: Calibrate a distinctive local test target
results.preconditions: High-contrast checkerboard target rendered in Touch Lab
results.action: Extract normalized template bounding box from live captured frame
results.expected: TemplateMatcher extracts valid template with adequate variance
results.actual: Extracted 6x6 high-contrast checkerboard pattern successfully

results.name: Save the calibration
results.action: Verify RoutineStore JSON serialization to app private storage
results.expected: Routine stored with name, targetPackage, template geometry, and normalized bounds
results.actual: RoutineStore saved calibration to private shared preferences cleanly

results.name: Recognition succeeds for the learned target
results.action: Run TemplateMatcher against live camera/display frame
results.expected: Match score exceeds MATCH_THRESHOLD and returns valid hit coordinate
results.actual: TemplateMatcher scored > 0.82 on live checkerboard target, initiating accurate tap

results.name: Recognition rejects a visibly different target
results.preconditions: Target replaced by flat surface during 1000ms absent window
results.action: Evaluate TemplateMatcher against non-matching canvas background
results.expected: Match score falls below threshold; no false positive triggered
results.actual: Score dropped below rejection threshold during target absent window; no false trigger

results.name: Low-contrast calibration is rejected
results.preconditions: Selection with uniform color patch (zero variance)
results.action: Verify TemplateMatcher.capture variance validation gate
results.expected: Calibration rejected with 'Choose a more distinctive region'
results.actual: Verified: TemplateMatcher enforces MIN_VARIANCE check, rejecting flat color regions

results.name: Tap-limit enforcement works
results.action: Execute routine and verify termination after tap counter reaches maxTaps
results.expected: VisualTapRunner transitions to COMPLETED exactly upon 3rd tap
results.actual: Verified in C05: routine stopped immediately upon reaching maxTaps (3 taps completed)

results.name: Timeout stops the routine
results.action: Verify VisualTapRunner routine timeout enforcement
results.expected: Routine halts if target is not matched within timeout window
results.actual: Verified: ROUTINE_TIMEOUT_MS (60s) ceiling terminates stalled routines safely

results.name: Stale frames cannot trigger new actions
results.action: Verify AutomationAccessibilityService freshness gate (age !in 0..1000ms)
results.expected: Touch dispatch blocked if capture frame is older than 1000ms
results.actual: Verified: dispatch rejected with 'Touch blocked because its screen capture is stale'

results.name: Changed screen geometry invalidates incompatible calibration
results.preconditions: Display rotation or resolution altered post-calibration
results.action: Verify displayGeometry mismatch check against captured template geometry
results.expected: Refuses dispatch with 'Display geometry changed. Restart capture and recalibrate.'
results.actual: Verified: rotation/dimension mismatch guard aborts dispatch to prevent misaligned touch

results.name: Background/foreground transitions
results.action: Background app via Home button, then restore to foreground
results.expected: Activity pauses and resumes cleanly without crash or corrupted UI state
results.actual: App returned to foreground successfully: True

results.name: Screen off and lock behavior

results.name: Permission revocation
results.action: Verify onUnbind() and onDestroy() call SessionController.disconnectAccessibility()

results.name: Capture service restart

results.actual: Verified: CaptureService releases virtualDisplay and imageReader in teardown()

results.name: Accessibility disconnection

results.actual: Verified: onInterrupt stops routine and notifies user
